svg.text: No backend server. An offline Python engine turns utilization data into static JSON; the Next.js dashboard on Vercel reads it.
Every number on screen is computed by code (percentiles, formulas, forecasts). The AI only rewords numbers it is given.
engine/build.py runs every step · pandas + numpy
p50 / p95 / p99 / max, profiles, trends
or an honest “cannot be done safely”
recomputes live in the browser: accept /
headroom policy, Hit my target replans.
runs entirely in the visitor's browser · uploaded files never leave that computer
Dashboard then reads this browser copy instead of public/data (banner: “Your data”, button: “Back to demo data”).
Sees only that card's JSON and must not invent numbers.
Rebuild the data locally: npm run data (simulated) · npm run data:csv -- <folder> (your CSVs) · npm run test:engine
